_comment: captured 2026-08-25, with rows borrowed from the unit8 and d-one accounts so one fixture covers
every case. parseBoard reads only `jobs`, so `name`/`description` at the top are inert.
CUT: department, employment_type, education, experience, function, industry, code,
application_url, and most of each description.
KEPT VERBATIM: title, shortcode, url, shortlink, city, state, country, locations (with its
ADVERSARIAL CASES, in order: (1) a Zürich job with a full locations array and both dates, where
published_on must win over the much older created_at — a req that sat in draft for a year would
otherwise be dated 2025 and fall foul of the LLM age cap; (2) a job Swiss ONLY via its locations
array, with no city/country on the job itself; (3) an Athens job, excluded; (4) a Lausanne job
with no `url`, which must fall back to `shortlink` rather than being dropped; (5) a Zürich job
with neither date, so postedAt is null; (6) a Swiss job with no shortcode, skipped.
name: Flexion Robotics
description: We at Flexion Robotics are a young company in Zurich.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: No url field, so the shortlink stands in rather than the row being dropped.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Intern
